data.title: Alert
data.tagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page
data.description: An alert sits near the related content and explains a status, risk, or problem without blocking the whole page. Use a heading, icon, and clear wording together to show importance; color alone is not enough.

use: A problem that remains relevant while the user works
avoid: Show a vague warning with no next step
Use red for every informational message
Remove an important alert before the problem is resolved

lessonPractice.title: An account expires in seven days. People may keep editing settings, but the renewal reminder must remain visible. How should it appear?

options.label: Keep an alert near the settings with the impact and a renewal action
options.feedback: The message remains visible without blocking editing and gives both the risk and a clear next step.

options.label: Show a two-second toast when the page opens and then dismiss it
options.feedback: An expiry reminder may require later action, so a brief disappearing message is too easy to miss.

options.label: Open a modal on every visit and prevent closing it until renewal
options.feedback: The account still works, so blocking the entire settings task overstates the current restriction.

data.agentPrompt: Add a persistent expiry alert near account settings with remaining days, impact, and a renewal action without blocking editing. Do not rely on yellow alone. Verify readability, the renewal action, and the product's intended dismissal behavior.
